messages:
incidents-bot: ALERT: unusual meter shadow spike detected for customer pkg-42. Shadowed token emitter showing +220% vs canonical for 2026-03-20T03:12Z. auto-pager -> @sre-oncall :rotating_light:
incidents-bot: Affected pipelines: emitter-v2 (eu-west1), shadow-agg (kafka-consumer-17). Potential symptoms: delayed batch ack, duplicate replays.
sre-oncall: on it. initial triage: are we seeing real charge flags to customers or just internal shadow counts?
billing-eng: seeing both. Primary billing ledger not yet fully updated but overage flagging service has fired for ~12 customers (no invoice yet). Most anomalies in embed/token counts.
sre-oncall: ok lock-step: 1) mute overage-alert emails (support-lead) 2) stop emitter retries (eng-runtime) 3) gather recent deltas (billing-eng)
support-lead: muting overage emails now (ticketing service -> suspend). Will post customer-facing hold note after we have decision. :white_check_mark:
eng-runtime: pausing emitter-v2 retries via feature-flag: `FLAG_EMITTER_RETRY=false` applied to eu-west1. Applying to dedicated pools next.
billing-eng: pulling last 6h diffs. quick query: `SELECT account_id, SUM(tokens) as t FROM shadow_counts WHERE ts > now()-interval '6 hours' GROUP BY account_id ORDER BY t DESC LIMIT 20;`
ops-product: any sign this is a backfill/late-emit vs double-counting?
billing-eng: initial sniff shows late-emit bursts from kafka partition 12 and consumer lag spikes around 02:45Z. Some messages reprocessed due to consumer restart. Suspect replays duplicated kvcache prefix.
sre-oncall: can we pause ingestion for affected partitions temporarily to stop growth?
eng-runtime: yes — pausing consumer group `shadow-agg-cg` for partitions [12,13] now. patch: `kafka-consumerctl pause shadow-agg-cg --partitions 12,13`
billing-eng: after pause, I see inflow drop. But backlog remains; we need a replay-safe backfill to reconcile without double-counting.
sre-oncall: plan: 1) pause retries 2) run dedupe pass on backlog checkpoint 3) replay only deduped payloads into canonical pipeline 4) reconcile counts and unflag customers. Who owns dedupe?
billing-eng: we own dedupe tool. kicking off `dedupe-v2 --source shadow-backlog --out reconciled-queue --id-key request_id` now. ETA ~14m.
support-lead: crafting short customer note: "We detected irregular usage signals for a subset of accounts which may have temporarily flagged overage warnings. We're investigating and suppressing alerts while we reconcile. We'll follow up within 2 hours." want to send?
sre-oncall: hold until we confirm no billing-impacting commits. Post internal hold now.
eng-runtime: dedupe job started. logs: ```2026-03-20T03:20:12Z dedupe-v2: read 1,234,567 events; dropped 482,119 duplicates; output 752,448```
billing-eng: running reconciliation on reconciled-queue to produce delta report. sample: `acct: 9001, shadow: 12,450 tokens -> canonical pending: 125 tokens delta` Looks like many accounts have small deltas but a few big ones.
sre-oncall: any customers already billed?
billing-eng: invoicing pipeline runs daily at 04:00Z — no invoices yet. We can avoid customer billing errors if we finish before that run.
ops-product: do we need to engage SRE infra for faster dedupe or scale?
sre-oncall: yes request extra worker nodes; ops-product please spin up 4x dedupe workers in eu-west1.
ops-product: scaling now. ETA 6m.
support-lead: turning off customer emails and setting status page to "investigating" now. note drafted.
eng-runtime: patch applied to stop emitter retries globally. also added a transient kvcache TTL clamp to prevent duplicate prefix reuse: `KVCACHE_TTL=30s`
billing-eng: reconciliation complete for top-50 accounts. we see 11 accounts with >10k token delta flagged. preparing script to unflag if delta < threshold after backfill.
sre-oncall: mitigation checklist: - overage emails muted (done) - emitter retries stopped (done) - consumer paused (done) - dedupe run (running/completed for backlog) - reconcile report (partial) - escalate to product for customer comms (ops-product)
support-lead: recommend sending interim note to impacted customers that we have suppressed alerts and will not charge until reconciliation complete. draft ready.
ops-product: agree. send after reconciliation completes for high-impact accounts.
eng-runtime: replaying reconciled-queue into canonical with idempotency keys enforced. replay logs: ```2026-03-20T03:34:01Z replay: reconciled-queue -> canonical, written 740k events, idempotent skips 480k```
billing-eng: final deltas applied. running flag clear script: `python clear_flags.py --max-delta 10000 --dry-run=false` queued.
sre-oncall: nice. timeline: incident opened 03:12Z, major mitigation done 03:35Z. still monitoring for residual drift.
billing-eng: flags cleared for 9/12 impacted customers. 3 accounts had legitimate usage spikes — support to confirm pricing.
support-lead: customer notes posted and direct outreach queued for the 3 accounts.
incidents-bot: Incident update: LEVEL=medium, duration=23m so far, mitigation: retry pause + dedupe + replay, customer impact: transient overage warnings suppressed, billing unaffected for invoices run before reconciliation window.
sre-oncall: closing pager to monitoring. will leave ticket open until tomorrow morning to ensure no late ripple. thumbs up? :thumbsup:
ops-product: +1
billing-eng: +1
eng-runtime: +1
support-lead: +1
incidents-bot: Incident closed by consensus at 03:55Z. Postmortem owner assigned: @billing-eng.
